artworks.title: Two Studies of a Child's Head; Two Studies of a Child's Head, a Woman in Profile, and a Man Wrestling an Animal [recto]
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink on wove paper
artworks.description: The image contains two panels of sketch studies on a plain background. The left panel shows two sketches of a child's side profile. The right panel includes various sketches: a front-facing view of a child's face, a side profile of another child's face, a draped sculpture with two embracing figures, and a side profile of an individual with delicate features and hair tied back.

artworks.title: Five Studies of Heads; A Boy in Profile with Studies of Hands and Feet [verso]
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink and graphite on wove paper
artworks.description: The image contains pencil sketches on a plain background divided into two sections. On the left side are sketches of faces from different angles and facial expressions. The right side features a sketch of a person in a side profile with detailed hair, along with simple sketches of a foot and hands. The image is set on a plain beige canvas with a thin dark border.

artworks.title: Address List; Manuscript Page [recto]
artworks.medium: page of notes; pen and brown ink , crayon, and graphite on wove paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of handwritten French text on paper. It features two pages side-by-side, both filled with cursive handwriting. The page on the left includes a list of names and addresses. The handwriting on this page is lighter and less dense than the one on the right. On the right page, there is a more extensive block of text titled "Note synoptique," exploring the relationship between painting and other sensory experiences, particularly sound, highlighted by intricate cursive. Both pages are bordered by a thin frame. The overall tone of the image suggests an aged document.

artworks.title: Manuscript Pages [verso]
artworks.medium: page of notes; pen and brown ink on wove paper
artworks.description: This is a photograph of two lined pages. The left page has handwritten cursive French text with some crossed-out words. The right page has a brief cursive line at the top. Both pages are bordered with lines. The paper looks old with slight discoloration.

artworks.title: "Neige" (Snow); Itinerary [recto]
artworks.medium: page of notes; graphite on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows several abstract lines and shapes on the right side, including two angular, elongated triangles, parallel jagged lines resembling waves, and narrow, slanted lines. On the left side, there is handwritten text with numbers followed by words.

artworks.title: Head of a Monkey; Inventory of Bottles and Beverages [verso]
artworks.medium: graphite, crayon, and pen and brown ink on wove paper
artworks.description: The image contains two panels filled with various thin pencil lines, creating an abstract composition. On the left panel, a series of random squiggly and straight lines meander across the page, intersecting in places. In the right panel, similar abstract shapes appear, some suggesting stones or polygons, with small dots and markings scattered within and around them.

artworks.title: Four Fantastic Forms [recto]
artworks.medium: graphite on wove paper
artworks.description: The image features abstract pencil sketches on a plain background. One sketch shows arch-like lines with textured top, resembling a small table or stool. Another sketch adjacent resembles a simple bridge or tunnel entrance. Below is a vertical sketch resembling a fountain. On the right, a long curved line intersects with other lines, possibly resembling a diving board or a serpent-like figure.

artworks.title: Color Chart with Annotations [verso]
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink on wove paper
artworks.description: This is an image of a color wheel with handwritten notes. The image features a radial diagram with colors labeled at the end of each line extending from a central point. The names of colors such as "jaune" (yellow), "rouge" (red), and "bleu" (blue) are written in French. Additional text below the diagram explains concepts related to colors, their complementarity, and primary colors. The piece is presented on a neutral background, with the ink giving a handwritten quality to the illustration and text.

artworks.title: Profile of a Boy and Self-Portrait [recto]
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink on wove paper
artworks.description: The image features two partial head portraits sketched on lightly textured paper. The top portrait shows the upper part of a person's head with a serene facial expression and closed eyes. The lower portrait portrays a man's side profile with a mustache, ear, beard, and loosely outlined hair. Both sketches lack any accessories or background elements.

artworks.title: Heads of a Boy and a Man (Self-Portrait?) [verso]
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink on wove paper
artworks.description: The image displays two profile sketches of heads on a plain background. The top sketch shows a side view of a person facing left, including the head and part of the neck with subtle facial features and hair. The head is framed within a grid. The lower sketch, inside a border, shows another profile with distinct facial features and simple hair rendering. The name "Gauguin" is written below the image. The background is neutral, with no additional items.

artworks.title: Three Studies of a Man Wearing a Hat [recto]
artworks.medium: crayon on wove paper
artworks.description: The image is a charcoal sketch showing partial profiles of two individuals, primarily focusing on their upper bodies and heads. The individuals are depicted in a seated position, with one person visible from the left side, while only the hat and top of the head of the other person are visible. The primary person has a prominent nose and facial hair, possibly a beard, and is wearing a wide-brimmed hat that obscures part of their face. The sketch suggests they are wearing a textured or layered garment. The second individual, at the bottom of the sketch, also wears a hat with a wide brim and appears to have a thick mustache. The lines suggest a loose and quick drawing style with minimal detail. The background is plain, emphasizing the figures without any additional scenery or context.

artworks.title: A Person Holding an Umbrella and a Seated Man with a Hat and a Glass [verso]
artworks.medium: crayon on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a rough sketch with minimal detail. In the foreground, there is a profile of a person wearing a broad-brimmed hat, obscuring most facial features. The person appears to be seated with arms crossed, and there is a cone-shaped glass in front of them. In the background, there is a sketchy outline of a person standing with an umbrella and a faint head sketch at the top right. The background is an unadorned, blank canvas emphasizing the simplicity of the sketch.

artworks.title: Head of a Cow [recto]
artworks.medium: graphite on wove paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two animal profiles. It depicts simple, minimalistic renditions of two animal heads, likely mammals, drawn with delicate pencil lines on a plain background. The upper section shows a head with defined features such as the mouth and eyes. Below is the sketch of another animal, focusing on the head and ears. The use of negative space highlights the simplicity and focus on the line work, giving the sketches a spontaneous and unfinished quality.

artworks.title: Two Cow's Heads [verso]
artworks.medium: graphite on wove paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a horse's head in two different poses. The sketch displays the profile of a horse's head drawn in a minimalist style with simple, flowing lines that capture the essence of the animal's structure and musculature. The horse’s head is drawn twice on the page, each representation focusing on different angles. The sketch includes key features like the eyes, nostrils, and outlines of the mane, rendered with light, swift strokes. The drawing emphasizes movement and form through its concise and expressive linework on a plain, unadorned background.

artworks.title: Head of a Bearded Man with a Head of a Dog [recto]
artworks.medium: graphite on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch on a beige or cream piece of paper. It depicts a rough drawing of a person's head and shoulders with facial features, including small, dark eyes, a prominent nose, a beard, and mustache. The person has medium-length dark hair styled to one side. Below the person's face is a simple outline of a dog's face with floppy ears, eyes, and a rounded nose. The background is plain with the paper's natural texture.

artworks.title: A Bearded Man and a Man in Profile [verso]
artworks.medium: graphite and crayon on wove paper
artworks.description: The image includes two partial sketches of men's faces and handwritten text. The first sketch, at the top right, shows about half of a man's face with a bowed head, downward curved eyebrows, a full beard, a short haircut, and a hat. The second sketch, below the first, is a side profile of another man with a prominent nose, pointed chin, neatly combed back hair, a thin mustache, and a collared garment. The sketches are surrounded by handwritten numbers and words, resembling a list or calculations, in faded pencil script. The background is plain and untextured, similar to aged paper.

artworks.title: Figure Seated on the Ground [recto]
artworks.medium: graphite on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of an individual's upper body in a reclining position, with one arm extended to the side and the other arm resting on a surface. The facial features are not detailed, and the head has an oval shape with a hint of a cap or head covering. The hair is suggested beneath the head covering. The person is dressed in a loose, long-sleeved garment, indicated by broad lines for the sleeves and upper torso. There are no jewelry or objects depicted. The background is a plain, unadorned surface.

artworks.title: Studies of a Cow [verso]
artworks.medium: graphite on wove paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of the outline of an animal. The image consists of loose, gestural lines sketching the form of a four-legged animal. The drawing captures the basic contours of the animal's face and torso with minimal detail. The lines are soft and slightly irregular, contributing to the spontaneous and natural feel of the piece. The simplicity of the lines highlights the fluidity of form and captures the essence of the animal rather than a detailed representation.

artworks.title: A Man Leaning on a Wall with Five Other Studies; Two Bearded Men Wearing Hats, and Five Other Studies [recto]
artworks.medium: graphite on wove paper
artworks.description: The image consists of sketches on two panels. On the left panel, there is a person viewed from behind leaning on a bar or railing, depicted from head to toe wearing a hat. Additional smaller sketches surround this figure, including facial profiles and headwear. The right panel primarily focuses on facial profiles and heads in different styles of headgear, such as caps and hats. The facial features are minimally detailed with simple lines. The sketches are done in pencil on a lightly colored paper, with a blank background.

artworks.title: Three Studies of Men's Heads, One with Spectacles; Dogs, Children, and Two Bearded Men in Profile [verso]
artworks.medium: graphite on wove paper
artworks.description: The image contains two pages filled with various pencil sketches. The left page shows sketches of individuals focusing on their head and shoulder areas. The top sketch depicts a person's face in partial profile with a head covering. Another sketch shows a back view of two individuals wearing hats. The right page also contains sketches of people, including two children and two dog-like animal figures in a sitting position. The background is plain with sketch marks and no additional context.

artworks.title: Two Figures and a Bench; Three Studies of Men's Heads and One of a Hand [recto]
artworks.medium: graphite, crayon, and pen and brown ink on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows two pages with pencil sketches. The left page features an abstract human figure with indistinct lines. The sketches on the right page include a head with partial facial features and a textured cap, a figure with a large nose and slicked-back hair, and a hand holding a paper or card. Light pencil notes, a name, and an address are visible above the sketches. The background is plain paper, and the pages are framed within a simple border.

artworks.title: A Breton Woman Walking; Sketch with Stairs [verso]
artworks.medium: crayon on wove paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two distinct sketches. The left panel features a rapidly drawn, sketch-like depiction of the back of a figure in motion or leaning forward. The right panel showcases a more abstract collection of lines and shapes, with a focus on horizontal and vertical lines, cloud-like forms, and other abstract shapes. The drawing is minimalistic, with fast, gestural strokes as the primary technique.

artworks.title: Two Head Studies and a Crouching Nude Woman; Two Women's Heads and a Head of Child [recto]
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink on wove paper
artworks.description: There are two panels on beige paper with sketches of heads and partial upper bodies. The left panel has two facial sketches, one in profile with a notable nose and messy hair, and another with closed eyes and basic facial features. The right panel shows more sketches, including a profile of a person wearing a hat with a ribbon, another profile with hair tied at the back, and a partial head with combed-back hair. The sketches are done with simple lines and shading, suggesting quick observational studies. The panels are separated by thin lines resembling a sketchbook.

artworks.title: Landscape with a Cottage; Profile of Boy, Profile of Man, Two Women in a Landscape, and Five Other Studies [verso]
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink on wove paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing with various sketches. The left side shows a landscape with a tree, a structure with a window, and a distant view. The right side has sketches of a child's face, a face in profile, and figures engaged in different activities. There are abstract features like a hat and figure outlines focusing on gestures and expressions. The ink drawing captures an artist's exploration of landscape and human form.
